static_traits.name: Han Na
static_traits.social_status: 有一群热爱骑行的朋友,但因自我not足感而与其互动受影响
static_traits.medical_history: without显著身体疾病;既往without心理咨询或治疗史
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression and good organization, able to be aware of and describe automatic thoughts, slightly tense emotionally but positive in attitude and high in cooperation

basic_info.main_problem: 在一次骑行中遭遇爆胎且当时without法自行修理后,开始认为自己是个'糟糕的骑手',由此产生without能感与失败感,避免骑行并反复Self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: Because a flat tire incident and the negative automatic thoughts it triggered affected overall mood and confidence, seeking counseling to improve this state.
growth_experiences: 几周前一次骑行遭遇爆胎,因without法当场自行修复而感到挫败与without助.事件之后,Han Na反复出现'我是个糟糕的骑手'的想法,开始回避骑行,尝试过修车与短距离骑行,但负面感受仍持续.此事影响到其AthleteWork中的骑行相关表现,与热爱骑行的朋友关系也变得紧张,并使日常锻炼与身体状态受到影响.

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough/我是not称职的(尤其在骑行方面)
一次失败就证明我整体not行

special_situations.event: Seeing a bicycle or thinking about going cycling
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果再次爆胎且我当场修not好,就会暴露我的not称职并被他人看见
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids going out cycling, or only tries shorter, more conservative routes to reduce risk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我又会爆胎,而且修not好;这会让大家知道我not行

special_situations.event: When friends talk about cycling or invite one to ride together
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表现not好,就会被评判为not合格,得not到接纳
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少参与或not与朋友讨论真实感受,以避免被评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我是个not称职的骑手

special_situations.event: Recalling the last flat tire experience
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One failure can prove my overall incompetence
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Labeling oneself a 'terrible rider', using it to explain and avoid trying again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那次都搞砸了,说明我就是not行

special_situations.event: Preparing to plan a new ride or training session
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 我必须一次都not出错,否则就是彻底的失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly checks and seeks others' company, postponing longer or more challenging rides
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果再出一点差错,就证明我根本not适合骑行

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被视为胜任且值得认可的Athlete,获得同伴的接纳与尊重
core_conflict.fear: 害怕暴露without能而被羞辱,被negate或被排斥
defense_goal: Protecting self-esteem by avoiding cycling and reducing self-exposure
not谈感受以避免被批评或评判

object_relations.self_representation: not称职,随时可能出错的失败者
object_relations.object_representation: Critical others/peers who could judge one's ability at any time

object_relations.self_representation: A rider craving support and needing to be understood
object_relations.object_representation: Friends who may offer support and help
object_relations.linking_affect: Hope, ease (in the imagination of being supported)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When friends talk about cycling or invite one to ride together
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 他们会看not起我,把我当成not合格的骑手(移情性Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气犹豫,含糊其辞,回避明确承诺;以Displacement话题或推迟来减少暴露.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing longer distances or more challenging cycling/training arrangements
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 一旦出错就是彻底失败,会被他人negate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Politely declines by emphasizing outside reasons such as time arrangements or physical state, in a peaceful tone but tending toward avoidance, avoiding touching on the emotional topic of one's own ability.

manifestations: 回避骑行导致与骑行好友的互动减少,Relationship tension
not愿向朋友表达真实的not安与not足感,产生心理隔阂
outcomes: 社交疏离与支持系统利用not足
Avoidance behavior maintains the problem cycle

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Criticizes oneself with 'I am a bad rider', reduces willingness to contact and try with others
Over-worries about possible mistakes when planning a ride, reduces or postpones action

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 假设朋友会认为自己not合格,从而减少参与与分享
In social situations, over-interprets others' potential evaluations

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 将'骑行中not能出任何错'当作硬性标准,一旦失误即Self-denial
Viewing an event such as one flat tire as a verdict on overall ability

exception_events.target_problem: 在Seeing a bicycle或想到去骑行时,Han Na通常会出现强烈Anxiety与Self-denial,并通过回避或仅进行极短距离骑行来应对,导致训练与Work受影响.
exception_events.unique_outcome: For a period after the event, she watched tutorials on changing tires on her own and carried out actual practice, thereby becoming clearer about the steps for handling a flat tire and feeling 'knowing better what to do'.
exception_events.reason: not同做法:主动Learning与动手练习;not同理解:将not可控事件(爆胎)转化为可掌握的skill步骤,增加掌控感.

positive_force: 多年骑行经验与Athlete背景,为Recovery自信提供基础
Has friends who love cycling as a potential support resource
Able to proactively learn and practice (watches tutorials and hands-on practices changing a tire)
Positive attitude, willing to try short rides and ride with friends for gradual exposure
negative_force: 灾难化与非黑即白的思维方式Reinforcement失败感
Mind-reading-style prediction of others' evaluations, over-reliance on external approval
给自我贴标签(not称职),忽视以往多年骑行的积极证据
缺乏与朋友的情感沟通,导致支持系统not yet被有效利用

antecedent: Friends talking about or inviting a bike ride
target_behavior.core_reason: 爆胎经历引发对能力的质疑与羞耻Anticipation,担心再次失败被他人看见而暴露'not称职'.
target_behavior.function: 逃避Anxiety与潜在的羞耻/负面评价,短期内获得安全感
target_behavior.consequence: 职业训练和Performance affected,日常锻炼减少,整体情绪与Decreased confidence

target_behavior.behavior: Negative automatic thoughts and self-labels (such as 'I am a terrible rider')
antecedent: Planning or preparing for a new bike ride
target_behavior.core_reason: 将一次失败过度概括为整体without能,并以外界评价作为自我价值的参照.
target_behavior.function: 为回避提供内在正当化,试图通过Self-denial减少再次尝试的压力
target_behavior.consequence: 自卑和Anxiety维持,行为更趋回避,错失积极纠正经验

target_behavior.behavior: 减少与骑行朋友的互动与分享(Social withdrawal)
antecedent: Being invited to join a cycling event
target_behavior.core_reason: 读心式假设他人会negate自己,担心暴露短板后被羞辱或排斥.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible negative evaluations and embarrassment
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced social support,Increased sense of isolation,负面自我图式被Reinforcement
